statement: Under the preceding assump- tions, moments with q source occurrences and at most two background arguments obey the ordinary Taylor rule through total background degree two, with error O(Uqs3) in the weighted projective norms. Background arguments already present in a tensor count toward that degree. With fewer source arguments the corresponding bound follows by Hölder. Moreover, u′ − Ld Tu v,q = O(Us), (4.16) and the output satisfies sup a,b evqna/p+vnb (E u′ a q ∞ h′ b p ∞)1/p ≤ Uq/p {Bss/8 + CL,Bs + o(s)}. (4.17) The choices of p, L, δ and the weights can be made before Bs and U. All these estimates retain any saved scalar’s carrier until after its weighted estimate is taken.
